Subject: Submission of Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call with Analysts / Investors held

Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we hereby 
inform you that the audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call with analysts / investors held on 
August 7, 2026, in relation to the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company 
for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, has been uploaded on the website of the Company and is available 
at 
the 
following 
link: 
https://cdn.olaelectric.com/sites/evdp/pages/investor/financials/fy27/q1/Earnings_Call_Q1_FY27.mp3  
 
The above intimation will also be hosted on the website of the Company i.e., www.olaelectric.com.  
 
We request you to take the above on your record. 
 
Thanking You,  
For Ola Electric Mobility Limited
